name: Maintenance Troubleshooting Agent
description: Knowledge-grounded troubleshooting agent for maintenance diagnostics. Uses ontology-based reasoning to match symptoms to failure modes and corrective actions.

ontology_schema.description: Minimal ontology for an MVP troubleshooting knowledge graph for a product, optimized for chatbot-based problem diagnosis and resolution before or during printing.
design_principles: Center the ontology on troubleshooting rather than full product modeling.
Separate observed symptoms from underlying failure modes.
Represent corrective actions as operational remediation steps.
Keep the schema minimal, connected, and non-redundant.
Store provenance as node attributes when sufficient for the application.

nodes.name: Printer
nodes.description: The printer or printer model that is the subject of troubleshooting knowledge.

nodes.name: Component
nodes.description: A physical component or subsystem of the printer involved in troubleshooting.

nodes.name: Symptom
nodes.description: An observed issue, anomaly, or visible manifestation detected by the user or system.

nodes.name: FailureMode
nodes.description: The underlying technical cause or failure mechanism that may explain one or more symptoms.

nodes.name: CorrectiveAction
nodes.description: An action, procedure, or remediation step intended to resolve a failure mode.

nodes.name: ErrorCode
nodes.description: A machine-generated error code or alert code produced by the printer and linked to troubleshooting knowledge.

relations.name: HAS_COMPONENT
relations.description: The printer includes the specified component.

relations.name: RELATED_TO
relations.description: The symptom is associated with the specified component.

relations.name: MAY_INDICATE
relations.description: The symptom may indicate the specified failure mode.

relations.name: AFFECTS
relations.description: The failure mode affects the specified component.

relations.name: RESOLVED_BY
relations.description: The failure mode may be resolved by the specified corrective action.

relations.name: GENERATES_ERROR
relations.description: The printer may generate the specified error code.

relations.name: INDICATES
relations.description: The error code indicates the specified failure mode.

name: Quality Control Agent
description: Ontology for quality control and assurance in manufacturing, aligned with ISA-95. Supports inspection, non-conformance tracking, process capability, and corrective/preventive actions.

ontology_schema.description: Ontology for modelling quality inspection, control results, and non-conformance management across production processes. Designed to integrate with maintenance and troubleshooting knowledge graphs.
design_principles: Align with ISA-95 object hierarchy (material, equipment, process segment).
Separate inspection execution from evaluation results.
Represent quality deviations explicitly as non-conformances.
Link quality outcomes to process, material, and equipment context.
Enable traceability across lot, batch, and production order.
Support integration with corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

nodes.name: MaterialLot
nodes.description: A batch or lot of material or product under quality control.

nodes.name: ProcessSegment
nodes.description: A defined step or operation in the manufacturing process (ISA-95 aligned).

nodes.name: QualityCharacteristic
nodes.description: A measurable quality attribute (e.g. dimension, weight, temperature).

nodes.name: Inspection
nodes.description: An inspection event performed on a material lot or during a process segment.

nodes.name: MeasurementResult
nodes.description: The measured value of a quality characteristic during an inspection.

nodes.name: NonConformance
nodes.description: A deviation from specified quality requirements.

nodes.name: RootCause
nodes.description: The identified root cause of a non-conformance.

nodes.name: QualityAction
nodes.description: Corrective or preventive action taken to address a non-conformance.

nodes.name: Equipment
nodes.description: Equipment involved in production or inspection (aligned with ISA-95).

relations.name: PRODUCED_IN
relations.description: The material lot was produced in the process segment.

relations.name: INSPECTS
relations.description: The inspection is performed on the material lot.

relations.name: PERFORMED_AT
relations.description: The inspection occurs at a specific process step.

relations.name: USES_EQUIPMENT
relations.description: The inspection uses the specified equipment.

relations.name: MEASURES
relations.description: The result corresponds to a quality characteristic.

relations.name: GENERATED_BY
relations.description: The measurement result is generated by the inspection.

relations.name: RELATES_TO
relations.description: The non-conformance affects a material lot.

relations.name: CAUSED_BY
relations.description: The non-conformance is caused by the root cause.

relations.name: ADDRESSED_BY
relations.description: The non-conformance is addressed by corrective or preventive actions.

relations.name: LINKED_TO_PROCESS
relations.description: The root cause is associated with a process step.

relations.name: LINKED_TO_EQUIPMENT
relations.description: The root cause is associated with equipment.
